nodes.name: Master Farmer title + permanent 10% herb yield bonus
The spire atop the Inkweald dream
Bone Pyramid full slayer lodge access + four Pyramid tasks
Immunity to Boneyard sandstorm disorientation — access deep dunes
First Empire Vault — permanent bank access inside the ruins, rare relic respawns
Crypt of Kings — advanced slayer + all 3 Bones of Fallen Kings trial rooms unlocked at once
Old Caravan Track — a pre-marked route with permanent respawn points for desert herbs and sand-wraiths. Only players who have walked the sister can navigate it without taking damage.
The Veiled Grave as a training altar + Moryskah-equivalent prayer hub
Crew Six Memorial — small shrine in the foundry outer wall; interact for 20% smithing-xp buff, one hour, once per day. Only unlocks if you chose Tell Brun or Tell Vorath.
Crew Seven Tunnel — a permanently lit, permanently open deep-mine passage with unique ore (soot-vein copper) and a re-pressurable shortcut between Sootworks and Heartlands mines.
Nessa's private cabin — a second seat at the Drifting Market; access to off-charter goods that do not appear in the public stall.
Edge-Keeper Trials — BiS endgame combat training hub
Mirrored Spire full agility course access
New Sun Zone — unlocked only if player chose to forge a new sun
Prophecy Chamber — under Orin's tower, contains a reading table that foreshadows all remaining grandmaster quests
Sage's Tower (yours, if you chose to succeed Orin) — contains the prophecy table and a bank
Witness Wall altar access + regional prayer hub
Simultaneous access to all 6 Heartlands guilds (cooking, fishing, crafting, mining, warriors, magic)
You may, at any future longest night, unlock the chapel altar yourself — the ONLY time any player holds that key.
Inner Chapel sanctum where dawn wax is tended
Chapel Undercroft — a small room under the altar, contains the finished prayer if you finished it
The Grand Hall — permanent Heartlands teleport hub with all 6 guild masters
Hidden crypt beneath the Chapel of the Last Light
Old Mill — flour processing, haunted farming (ghost-touched crops grant 2x XP)
Private Kitchen in the Guild — your own range, farm plot, and fishing pond on-site
The sister's cottage — a private bank access point in the Heartlands, along with a vegetable patch that produces a unique seed if you posted the letter.
Throne Room with a permanent advisor seat — player gains political voice
Backwards Garden herb patches (grow in reverse; harvest before planting)
The upper stacks open. The shelves rearrange when you're not looking.
Lunar Plane — accessible from Inkweald, unique runecrafting
Pageturn Court opens. The door was always last. Now it opens.
Second Door Chambers — seven layered dream rooms, each with a unique puzzle
Third Grove — a private meditative space, the mirror remains for future visits
Inner Crystal Caverns — accessible only post-alignment, contains refraction-only herb patches, a mirror-forge for unique crafting, and Orin as a permanent consultant.
Crossroad Shrine — a small temple appears at the seventh crossroad, accessible only to you
Vampire Cabaret Royal Box — the only seat the director trusts her understudy in; the champagne is warm and iron-y
Castle Malachar throne room — player gains a seat at the long supper where nothing is eaten and everybody is very polite
Hollow Choir Loft — where the third voice lives; it is the only voice that remembers the entire hymn
Hallowvale — the vampire quarter, late-game Moryskah content
Haunted Mine — unique glowing coal that ignores smelting penalties
Mortton Temple — blessed pyre site, shade minigame
Barrows Sisterhood Library — pew-by-pew access to the full archive of brother-wills, each of which has codicils the brothers wrote after their funerals
Access to the Slayer Tower basement — creed stone, rare banshees, permanent respawns
The Werewolf Estate — fully explorable, contains a private bank, a shrine, and a locked room
The Witch's Grove — a small perfect patch of her swamp that cannot be found by accident
Wolfbane Distillery back vault — deepest fermentation hall, only the foreman and the eldest distiller have ever set foot in it
Old Sun Cavern — accessible only via the waxed compass after this quest. Contains a daily refreshable herb patch that grows ingredients not found elsewhere.
Pyramid Sixth-Level Archive — accessible only if the chain is complete. Each chosen ending grants a different entry cadence (never, monthly of Euthren, or permanent).
Counterfeit Vault — a stash with three bank tabs that only you can access
Crow's Nest Range — sniper-shot rigging range, high-tier ranged training with storm-sway mechanic
The Drifting Market — floating bazaar that rotates between coastal ports; exclusive stock weekly
Ghost Anchorage — unique fishing + ranged content
Throne Rocks — your seat, a private bank, and a balcony overlooking the open sea
The Wreck Coast — boat-only deep-water fishing grounds. Unique fish not found elsewhere.
Cinder King's Graveyard — slayer contract zone
Deep Stone Alloy Works — endgame smithing facility
Foundation Seam — unique mining area with hot-vein ore, fire-wight respawns
Geyser Dock — deepwell fishing spot + pressure-pot cooking station adjacent
Library stacks — forge-crystal vein, scroll bench, archivist shop
Pilgrim cloister — rest + prayer restore spot, Brass Choir side chapel
Lower Pump Eight — agility-exclusive sprint zone
Slag Tunnels access — golem-spawn, pipehounds, deep-foundry monsters
Titan Floor — a hangar deep below the Sootworks, your Titan rests here
Ent grove — level-thirty wilderness farming hub
The Exiled Camp — safe pocket inside wilds, glory + bank access
Lava Maze runite cluster access — deep-wild mining node
Third-Ditch plateau — full access to Callisto/Vet'ion/Venenatis pocket zones
The Hidden Court — full treetop agility course + duelist arena
Mooncourt altar access — lunar dust sieve, moon-tide crystal shallows
The Moonwell — only outsider-accessible spring in the Inner Sanctum, infinite prayer refill once per day
The Whisper Glade — dream-herb patch, wake-flower harvests
Black Obelisk — a single safe spot in deep Wilds (bank access, one-way teleport out)
Revenant Throne — your throne now, a private camp in deep Wilds with PvP-safe bank
Barrows Brothers fight unlocked — 6 bosses, degradable set drops
Cerberus slayer boss — BiS boot upgrades
Cinder King Revenant — yearly boss encounter
Deep Kraken Prime — Saltbrine prestige boss
Deep Kraken — repeatable boss fight for tentacle drops and sailors-necklace charges
Eclipse Guardian — post-game boss with unique drop table
The Evil Chef — Grand Feast prestige boss. 3 phases: Soup, Main, Dessert. Drops Culinaromancer Gloves.
Frostwyvern Matron — end-boss of the Deepkeep vault
KBD as repeatable boss (drops dragon bones stack + KBD head)
Lord Malachar boss fight — drops Scythe of Malachar
Tower Sparring — repeatable 1-on-1 vs the matriarch. She holds back. Mostly.
Salted King Hard Mode — extreme attention, drops the Sun-King Cape (i)
The Salted King — repeatable hourly attack training boss
Pharaoh Senekhet repeatable — grandmaster boss in the re-sealed tomb with unique drops
The Clockwork Heretic boss — rogue master-smith, mid-game Sootworks prestige
The Dreaming One — Inkweald prestige boss
The Dreaming One — repeatable grandmaster boss in whichever ending state you chose
The Exiled Champion — quest-unique boss, drops blade shard
The Swamp Made Flesh — optional repeatable grandmaster boss in her old cottage, drops unique herblore secondaries
The Teleblocked King — prestige boss, wilderness-crown drop
Abyssal pouches — carry more essence per run
Alden's Patrol Cloak — back slot, +2 prayer, Heartlands NPCs volunteer information
Amulet of No-Honor — wilds BIS amulet, stackable 1000/slot
Amulet of the Damned — enhances all Barrows set effects. Prestige.
Ankh of Rebirth — amulet, one per-day free respawn without item loss, +3 prayer
Answered Antler Cape — BIS prayer-switch cape in dream-kind combat; reflects a single hit per minute
Anti-dragon shield — required to fight any dragon without taking massive damage
Apprentice's Hammer — lighter, never breaks, works on all tiers up to rune
The archive ending you chose is permanent and canon. Downstream dialogue in the Last Prayer, Cartography Grandmaster, and the Second Question content all reference it.
Archivist gauntlets — required to handle archive scrolls

Aureth's Scribe-Ring — ring slot; while equipped, you age the world's ledgers by 1 line whenever you complete a major action (XP drop, boss kill, quest). The ledgers matter for late-game content (Last Prayer chain extension).
Barrows Gloves — BIS melee hand slot, the iconic mid-game achievement
Beggar-Hem Coat — Gallery beggars never call guards when worn
Bell-rope coil — braided for the Chorus
Bel's Cipher Crib — pocket, lets you read any cipher-tagged note in the world. Includes Crown dispatches, Moryskah smuggler contracts, and Drifting Market charters if you also have the charter.
Birth-Name Amulet — small permanent stat bonus; ONLY given by hedge-wise women after they record your name
Blade of the Wilds (final) — BIS wilds melee, stackable 1000/slot
Blade of the Wilds (upgraded) — +25% damage vs PKers, degrades on death
Bog Witch's Hat — her hat. Fits you now. Halves potion ingredient cost at any herblore bench.
Boneyard Compass — navigate desert without water loss
Brazer's Guilty Apron — body slot, -12% smithing bar burn chance, inscription changes by ending.
Broken Crown Charter — free charter-ship travel anywhere the flag is respected
Brother's Glass Marble — pocket; sandstorms and heat-effects do -50% damage to you while you hold it. Non-tradeable. Placed in bank, the protection ends.
Cabaret Season Ticket — cosmetic pocketwatch; each matinee attended adds a chime
Canopy Hunting Permit — required to set traps in canopy zone
Captain's Bond Relic — grants the Kraken-Warding prayer, negates drowning damage below 10 HP
Captain's Hook — cosmetic weapon + 5% fishing speed on boats
Caravan-master token — permanent +10% trade prices in Glass Desert
Weekly Charter Voucher — 3 free charter trips per week between any Charter House ports in Aelgard
Cog-bone charm — required for safe Graveyard contracts
All three trust you at a level none of them would name aloud. You can deliver letters between any two of them without a charter fee.
Comet Shard Pendant — amulet, +3 to magic/prayer, once per day sends a message to any player on the server
Compact Signet — worn on the left hand; opens Lamplighter shortcuts everywhere

Consecration Rubbing of the Seventh — pocket; when held, any grave marker in Aelgard will show its true carving for twelve seconds. Use at the Mortton, Heartlands chapel, or Sootworks crypt for separate lore unlocks.
Coronation Cloak — a cosmetic cape woven from seven regional threads
Triple Courier Sash — three-color set required for escort runs
Court Slippers — +10% agility stamina regen in Veilwood
Crystal-Hunter's Mark — unlocks crystal-hunter pet route (1/3000 from contracts)
Crystal Wyrm Scale Cape — BIS prayer-switching cape
Culinaromancer Gloves — BIS melee gloves in early-mid game. Iconic prestige reward.
Pristine Culinaromancer Gloves — upgrade of Barrows Gloves with cooking bonuses
Decoy-Maker's Stamp — pocket; lets you create one per-day forgery of any simple document you have legitimately seen. Forgeries pass most NPC checks; they never pass Father Dorin's.

Decree-Rubbing of the Thirteenth — pocket; once per in-game year, lets you invoke the thirteenth month as a single day when no official calendar action may be taken against you (no quest timer expires, no NPC enmity ticks).
Deep Stone Apron — worn by charter-signed smiths only. Permanent +8% smithing XP in Sootworks
Desert Amulet — +3 prayer in Boneyard, sand-walking
Full Dharok's: damage scales inversely with HP
Distiller's Apron — gives a small herblore bonus at any distillery; pockets remember last night's ash even after laundering
Can now equip Dragon Hunter Lance — BIS against all dragons
Can now equip dragon scimitar (requires quest completion, not just level)
Dream-Anvil Hammer — forges ideas into metal; +5% smithing XP in Inkweald
Dream Talisman — teleports to the last place you dreamt of (server-side history, last 7 days)
Dreamer's Sigil — grants the Lucid spellbook while equipped, even outside Inkweald
Druid's Covenant Staff — main-hand for druids; heals on hit when wielded during daylight in Veilwood
Elder Crown — head slot, +1 to every Veilwood skill level for methods in the Inner Sanctum
Enchanted gem — check slayer task remotely
Sand-Hawk Falconry Glove — required for falconry method
Ferryman's Whistle — calls the ferry to any lit lantern; a forfeit per blow; the forfeits are the point
Fire Cape — BIS melee cape until Infernal Cape. The prestige item.
First Empire Signet — ring, grants the First Empire Queen as a one-time quest-answer oracle (any quest, any question)
First Torven Tally — pocket slot; Greta will now let you mine in her private seam (no competition) for one real-time hour per day.
Forgemaster stamp — required for master-grade work at every Aelgard forge
Foundling's Lantern — light source + passive hunter bonus in the dark
Gearbound Pilgrim Cassock — +2 prayer, prayer bonuses stack at Brass Choir
Heretic's Bellows (Gilded) — upgraded for master burns
Glass-Stag Pelt Cape — +5% ranged accuracy in Veilwood; catches moonlight
Glass-Walker's Sash — +4 agility in Glass Desert, cannot be sold
Golem Repair Manual — used to control golems in later quests
Grandmaster Slayer Helmet — combines creed ring, full helm slot, +15% slayer damage all regions
Guild feast apron — worn only at the kitchen
Guild Medallion — reduces all guild entry requirements by 5 levels
Hald's Loaned Hammer — main-hand for smithing only, +3 smithing level equivalent at any anvil, returns to Hald on death; replaceable via dialogue.
Heretic's Bellows — +8% firemaking XP in Sootworks permanently
Hermit's Bronze Key — key slot; fits one lock in Aelgard, which you will not find without the grandmaster quest. Keeping it equipped shows no function yet.
You hold the calendar. Keeper Aureth will, in the final quest, recognise this without your saying so.
Index Keystone — indexes any book you own; scrolls you've read become teleports
Infernal Cape — BIS cape in the entire game. Ultimate prestige.
Mirror Shard — pocket slot, reveals one PKer's intent per day, shows you a glimpse of one possible future once per session
Inspector's Loupe — identify fake items, bonus thieving success
Jess of Quiet Thanks — glove slot; hunter traps placed with this equipped will never frighten songbirds within 12 tiles
KBD head trophy — Aelgard's first dragon trophy, hung in any POH
Kin-Rite Brass Bell — pocket, silences the noise-penalty on hunter traps within 20 tiles; Boneyard-only bonus: traps there recharge 50% faster.
You know what actually happened. Certain Crown NPCs will refuse to speak to you. Hilde will trust you deeply.
You know. Brigh knows you know. Reed does not ask. This enables a later Master quest about the Bittern's final voyage.
You know the lamp is her first husband's. This unlocks a very short, private line with Father Dorin about the chapel longest-night burn.
You know the month's name. This line unlocks specific exchanges with Dorin, Bel, Veris, and Keeper Aureth (chain-6).
You know the Old Sun is the moon. This line unlocks in conversations with Crystal Sage Orin, the Inkweald Muse, and the Crystal Wyrm.
You know the name of the household. Unlocks a private line with Merchant Hilde.
Kraken Tentacle Whip — BIS one-handed slash weapon until the Wyrm tier
Lantern of the Dreamless — holds a single wish for one night; burns no fuel while held by a sleeper
Last Prayer Sigil — ring, +5 prayer, auto-activates once per fight when you hit 1 hp
You are the fourth person to whom Lenna has said thank you. A small NPC dialogue flag used by later quests.
Lenna's Smaller Net — pocket; when fishing at tide pool spots, occasionally catches a second fish of a lower tier. Non-tradeable. Does not take an inventory slot when stored in a sack.
Lens-forge hammer — required for crystal-cored smithing, +6% smithing XP at Lens Forge

Longest Night Rite Token — pocket; grants a once-per-year ritual at the Heartlands chapel that resets a single 'grief' or 'guilt' dialogue flag set on you by another quest. Non-tradeable, ritual available only on the longest night.
Lost God's Sigil — neck slot, bound to your apotheosis outcome, stats vary by path chosen
Lucid Staff — BIS magic staff for lucid/dream spells, +15% spell damage in Inkweald
Lunar Rune Pouch — holds 3× essence, usable at any Veilwood altar
Mage Arena cape — autocast god spells, wilds-only bonus
Map of Maps — consumes a slot, teleport to ANY previously-visited location once per hour, updates in real time
Market Charter Seal — ring slot, grants discounts or partial ownership at the Drifting Market depending on outcome
Master brewer apron — required at the master still
Master Chef's Apron — chest slot, halves burn rate at any range, cooking XP +10%
Memory-glass cipher — reads old dune-script, unlocks Dunewright master contracts
Midnight-Cousin's Pendant — one dream-farming run per day auto-succeeds
Militia Archer's Badge — +5% ranged accuracy at the range
Mirror-Shard Shield — reflects 1 spell per fight; BIS for magic-heavy bosses
Mother Oreline's Loupe — upgraded Inspector's Loupe, identifies all fakes at a glance, +10% thieving
Nessa's New Map — right-click any Boneyard tile to teleport once per hour; updates when dunes move
Old Sun Sigil — ring slot; one-time use, lets you overwrite the outcome of any single future quest choice. Permanent in the world after use.
Orin's Spectacles — let you read any prophecy glyph in Aelgard, reveal hidden dialogue on NPCs
Palate of the Grand Hall — cape slot, +2% cooking burn reduction, unique inscription visible to other players that depends on your ending
Papers of Convenience — allows the player to pass any border check-point in any region as a citizen-in-transit; one use per in-game night
Pearl-Diver Token — 24-hour +40% pearl yield bonus after completion
Pharaoh's Crown — head slot, +2 prayer, grants Sand Form (brief sand-storm immunity) once per hour
Philosopher Robes — daily free magic teleport
Pipe-ember censer — prayer bonus when bones on offer
Pirate King's Crown — head slot, +3 prayer, commands respect in any coastal town
Pitch-Fork Saw — a saw that tunes itself; works on every Veilwood log
Plague Doctor's Mask — head slot, poison immunity, +5% herblore success
If you kept any notes, you possess unique deep-Sootworks cartography. Enables a post-quest micro-activity: sell individual pages to specific NPCs (e.g. Brun would pay for one, Vorath for another).
Post-Mistress's Seal — marks any letter sent by the player as 'previously filed' in the Moryskah drawer system; solves a cascade of lore problems at once

Pre-Crown Calendar Roll — pocket; lets you read any pre-Crown-dated document in the world. Includes Pyramid glyphs, chapel ledgers, Drifting Market ledgers, Sootworks oaths, Veilwood ring-counts, and Crystal Wyrm refractions. Unique to this chain.
Prism-burst tome — unlocks prism-burst BiS combat magic spell
Prophet's Waterskin — holds 50 cactus waters, never loses a drop to the sun
Pump Eight Wrench (Master) — permanent +3 agility in Sootworks
Pumpman's Wrench — permanent +2 agility on any Sootworks course
Pyramid Blue-Pulse Pattern — pocket; lets you detect time-loop enchantments (any object being returned-to-itself) within 20 tiles. Unique to the archivist chain.
Quenchmaster's Tongs — +5% smithing XP at Sootworks forges
Quiet Count Regalia — a cosmetic set woven from seven regional mourning-cloths
Rancher's Bell — summons pet cow (cosmetic + farming timer)
Ranger's Survival Kit — one-click teleport to Wilds border (one use)
You have read the poem. This line unlocks a single exchange with Veris about her brother and a single exchange with the Hermit about unsent letters.
Reagent Road Map — marks 23 hidden reagent caches across every region
Both Mirelda and Nira treat you as family. Grael pretends not to, but lowers her prices by 20%.
Reed's Knot-Thread — pocket, re-ties itself if severed. Worn while crafting, adds a 'binding' tag to any player-made container — contents cannot be pickpocketed by other players.
Reed's Trip Log — pocket, reveals the location of every bittern-catchable species within a region; single-use per day. Non-tradeable.
A Remembered Line — fishing line that catches what-was-promised; never tangles
A Remembered Scroll — replays your last potion recipe for free, once per day
Dorin will, unprompted, refer to you as 'renewer' in all future chapel dialogue. Mirelda will notice and not comment.
Razak's cousin, if you meet him again, will recognise you by the bell.
Revenant Ether Mace — crush weapon, BIS Wilds-only, consumes ether per hit
Revenant Oath Relic — pocket slot, +15% damage vs revenants, bleeds if you break the oath (kill anyone unprovoked)
Ring of No-Honor — teleport delay +2 ticks in wilds, +8% damage vs other PKers
Royal Falcon pet — +10% hunter success rate anywhere in Aelgard
Royal Warrant — required to cross protected regional borders
Rune crossbow equippable — prayer + shield + ranged
Ruven's Rune Pouch — holds 3 types of runes in one inventory slot
Shipwright's Adze — construction tool. Works on wood-tier furniture 1 level lower than normal.
Salve Amulet — +16.7% damage + accuracy vs undead. Game-changing for Moryskah PvM.
Sandglass Staff — BIS magic staff Glass Desert-only, resets one cooldown per minute
You saw yourself in a possible future. This enables a very small, very late Master miniquest about that weapon she carried.
You have seen a date older than the Crown's official founding. This line unlocks specific exchanges with Veris, Bel, and the Hermit.
Sessen's Last Jess — glove slot; bonds to the next bird you train (hunter) for a permanent +5 to hunter level while that specific bird is alive; non-tradeable.
Silent Lifter — thieving gloves; your target never hears the chime
Silver Sickle — werewolf-slaying weapon, bless water remotely
Singing-glass chisel — required for crystal-rune crafting
Sisterhood Sigil — small permanent defensive bonus; only given after the youngest Sister reads your name aloud over the fourth brother
Slayer's Creed Ring — 5% damage boost vs any creature a master has ever assigned
Soot Road Ledger — stamped once per cache by the Road Warden
You have named Keeper Aureth to Razak and the Hermit. This unlocks the grandmaster quest's availability.
Steampunk Greataxe — two-hand slash, BIS until the wyrm tier, consumes fire-iron bars as charges
Sun-King Cape — prayer cape with +12% damage vs undead, worn over the shoulders of the Salted King's killer
Sun-King Cape (i) — imbued prestige cape, +18% vs undead, one prayer restore per minute
Third Cipher Final Crib — pocket; the ONLY way to read Crown dispatches written before the current Crown took office. Unique to the player who finishes this quest.
Third-Turn Compass — always points to what you were looking for two steps ago
Third Voice Stole — magic bonus while any choir sheet is in inventory
Tide Pool Net — catches unique fish not available elsewhere
Tinker master-pin — required at the master line
Toxic blowpipe equippable — fastest ranged weapon
Tray-keeper token — access to master trays
Triple Guild Pin — signed by all three guilds. +1 smith, +1 crafting, +1 agility at Sootworks stations
Bel and Veris both trust you. Veris will now dictate a weekly field journal entry you can mail between them.
Mara and Nessa both treat you as family. They have still not told you the nature of their dispute. You will not learn it from them.
Tsunara, in future encounters, will not attack you on the first phase. She will accept instead a single gesture: wrap the shade-cloth once.
Tsunara's Wave-Sigil — ring; when worn underwater, grants +3 agility and a unique dash mechanic that leaves a wave-trail damaging nearby enemies. Useless on dry land.
Under-Glyph Rubbing — pocket; lets you read any glyph wall written in the under-script. Chain-gated; unique to this chain. Non-tradeable.
Vigil Stole — prayer bonus when dawn wax is in inventory
Voss's Tinderbox — 10% faster firemaking, works on blessed wood
Werewolf Family Token — summons the heir once per week as a combat ally of scaling power
The Matriarch's Tooth — amulet, grants lycanthrope-sight (see werewolves in crowds), +5 prayer
Wilderness Blade — BIS in the Wilds only, useless outside. Niche sidegrade.
Wilderness Crown — head slot, +15% damage in Wilds, revenants will not attack first
Wind-Numbered Anklet — tells you the hour the wind has its number (reduces stamina drain in Boneyard by 50%)
You wrote it. This unlocks a very short conversation with Mirelda (the bog witch) about the two letters she and Alden exchanged during the Sootworks campaign, which were both burned.
If you chose Align: permanent +1 to a stat of your choice (selectable once, irreversible).
Wyrm-Scale Cape — cape; refracts one incoming attack per encounter into damage against the attacker. Inscription changes by ending chosen.
The Dragon's Tithe Cape — cosmetic; earned by returning the first wyvern visage
Yara's Quill — pocket, usable once per in-game day to write a short ward onto any object; ward persists one hour, protects one skill check from failure.
Access to Deadhold undead survival minigame
Dusk Relay minigame — cross-region lamp-lighting sprint
Forgotten Passage Relay — cross-region ferry-lantern sprint; the prize is unclaimed mail
Rivet Debate minigame — public defence on behalf of one guild; reward rotates
Access to The Ascendancy roguelike combat minigame
Alden, Dorin, and Kael will, once per in-game season, invite you to Friday drinks at the Crow. You are the fourth chair. The cat attends.
Alden promotes you to patrol quartermaster — access militia stores, request backup once per day
Aldwin will now, once, say the phrase 'mind the glove' instead of 'visitor'. Do not point it out.

If you freed her, Aureth will walk the world. She will appear, once per in-game month, at the Salt-Pickled Crow on Wednesday, to speak with Brigh and (separately) with you. If you sealed her, she corresponds via the archive monthly. If you took her place, your character is now an NPC to other players between play sessions, writing in the archive — a unique multiplayer-adjacent feature.
Bog Witch available as herblore tutor (unique swamp potions)
Bog Witch now teaches grandmaster herblore — extends potion effect durations by 20 per cent
Brigh will, in later content, consult you about his own decision to buy a boat. Your choice in this quest shifts his timeline.
Nessa takes you on as partner — commission new maps for unique teleport unlocks
The chancery clerk will, from now on, forward one anonymous dispatch per in-game month to your bank.
CURE PATH: Human NPC shopkeeper in werewolf territory (herblore supplies)
Father Dorin will, once per in-game month, give you a private sermon of exactly three sentences that grants a prayer-xp buff for the next real-time hour.
Dunewright Master — issues master construction contracts
The Chef will now either retire quietly (Publish), keep cooking alone (Bury), or begin teaching at Hilde's back door (Anonymous) — determines where he appears next.
Father Urhney available as exorcism tutor
Brun's contract desk — signs your warrant, stamps your apron
Gallery Elder — gives the petition, signs your hem-coat
Bog Witch Grael will, once per in-game season, brew a poultice for you from a plant that does not grow anywhere else. Cost is a single unaltered ledger-page.
Greta calls you by an old nickname of her first husband's. She does not realise she does it. Do not correct her.
Lens-cat ally — follows the player, +3 hunter in Glass Desert, spots traps at 3 tiles
Master Thief Quartermaster — sells thieving-exclusive tools and lockpick sets
Nessa retires from field work — you inherit her commission ledger, assign yourself map-quests for rewards
Nira now teaches the swamp salve song to any player who has completed this quest. Mirelda has permanently forgiven her.
Orin will, post-quest, sell you answers to any single skill-related question in the world for a tithe of fifty of any ore.

If you chose Tell Brun, Ossen now openly sells deep-tunnel maps in the Soot-Mouth. If you chose Tell Vorath, Ossen becomes a reluctant foundry consultant. If you chose Burn, Ossen still drinks alone but will give you a free stout once per in-game week.
The Parched Prophet — dialogue hub, daily riddles that reward desert teleports
Plague Doctor travels the three regions — dispenses daily rare-herb assignments
Razak will now sell wind-knowledge at the fair price — cuts travel time across the Boneyard by 30% for your account.
Razak will, from now on, volunteer wind-knowledge free of charge. He will also, once, tell you the name of the lost caravan, if you earn it.
Captain Reed will, once per in-game week, carry you to any Saltbrine-shoreline region for free. He will mention the soft board every time.
Aldwin lets you handle Sessen. Once per day, Sessen will fly a short message to any NPC in the Heartlands for you.
Salt-Tongue — sailing master and sea-witch tutor, opens advanced charter combat and magic paths
Your quartermaster will now charter any vessel you name, for a fee
The Sand Prince will grant one reading per in-game week. Readings give yes/no answers to single questions about time-bound content.
Seed-Keeper — your midnight-cousin; gives dream-seeds nightly
Novice slayer task assignments from Slayer Apprentice Kael
Iron-Tongue slayer master — issues clockwork-construct contracts
Slayer Master Varrek — intermediate+ slayer tasks in Moryskah
Ossen, Fizz, Hald, Brun, and Vorath will, exactly once per in-game year, meet in the back room of the Crow. You are the only player permitted to watch.
Sootworks Titan — permanent combat summon, takes 1 fire-iron bar per fight to run

If you chose Sign, the Muse retires and becomes a pen-pal for any player with a live-ink jar. If you chose Leave, the Muse remains a boss respawn. If you chose Partial, the Muse appears as an NPC art-tutor at the Drifting Market once per week.
The Slayer Master Who Is Not There Until You Walk Past Her
Three Guildmasters — Smiths, Tinkers, Pumpmen. All three argue who invented the rivet. Player arbitrates.
